chapter.heading: Prayer for Relief from AdversariesTo the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. To bring to remembrance.
chapter.v:
Make haste,
O God, to deliver me!Make haste to help me, O Lord!

Let them
be ashamed and confoundedWho seek my life;Let them be turned back and confusedWho desire my hurt.

Let them
be turned back because of their shame,Who say, “Aha, aha!”

Let all
those who seek You rejoice and be glad in You;And let those who love Your salvation say continually,“Let God be magnified!”

But I
am poor and needy;Make haste to me, O God!You are my help and my deliverer;O Lord, do not delay.
